ui.judge: The user makes the decisions. This tool only helps with preliminary checks and record keeping.
ui.code_note: Country, currency, port and similar codes are checked for format only. Whether a code actually exists is not checked.

hints.decimal_string: Amounts, quantities, weights and unit prices are written as quoted strings, not numbers (e.g. "22500.00").
hints.integer: Counts and numbers are written as integers without quotes (e.g. 18).

reasons.syntax: it is not written as a path
reasons.not_allowed: only authoritative items such as parties, trade terms, transport, lines and totals can be compared with document values
reasons.not_found: there is no item at that location
reasons.not_scalar: point to a single value, not a whole group

FILE_UNREADABLE.fix: Check the file location and name.

ENCODING_INVALID.why: The file is not encoded in UTF-8.
ENCODING_INVALID.fix: Save the file again as UTF-8.

JSON_INVALID.why: The file cannot be read as JSON ({where}).
JSON_INVALID.fix: Fix missing or extra brackets, quotes or commas.

ROOT_NOT_OBJECT.why: The outermost value is not an object (curly braces).
ROOT_NOT_OBJECT.fix: Write one shipment as one object.

VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.why: Version "{value}" is not supported by this validator (supported: {supported}).
VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Set contract_version to a supported version, or use a validator for that version.

REQUIRED_MISSING.fix: Add the item. Items cannot be omitted. If the value is unknown, write null (only where null is allowed).

REQUIRED_NULL.why: This item is required and cannot be null.

UNKNOWN_FIELD.why: "{key}" is not an item in this version.
UNKNOWN_FIELD.fix: Check the spelling. If it is your own item, move it under ext.<project name>.

EXT_INVALID.why: Only "project name: object" pairs may be placed directly under ext (problem at: {key}).
EXT_INVALID.fix: Put your own items under ext.<project name> as an object. A project name starts with a lowercase letter and uses only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

EMPTY_VALUE.why: The value is an empty string.
EMPTY_VALUE.fix: Provide a value. If it is unknown, write null (only where null is allowed).

OUT_OF_RANGE.fix: Use a value within the range.

SCHEMA_VIOLATION.why: The data does not follow the schema ({detail}).
SCHEMA_VIOLATION.fix: Check the relevant part of schema/shipment.schema.json.

CONTAINER_CHECK_DIGIT.why: The check digit of container number "{value}" does not match (calculated {expected}, written {actual}).
CONTAINER_CHECK_DIGIT.fix: Check the container number against the document again. It may have been copied incorrectly.

CONTAINER_DUPLICATE.why: Container number "{value}" appears more than once.

LINE_CONTAINER_UNKNOWN.why: Container number "{value}" is not listed in transport.containers.
LINE_CONTAINER_UNKNOWN.fix: Use a number listed in transport.containers, or add the container. Use null for cargo that is not in a container.

LINE_NO_DUPLICATE.why: Line number {value} is used more than once.
LINE_NO_DUPLICATE.fix: Give each line a different line number.

TOTAL_MISMATCH.why: The total does not match (the lines add up to {expected}, but {actual} is written).
TOTAL_MISMATCH.fix: Check which is correct, the lines or the total, and fix it.

DATE_ORDER.why: The estimated arrival date ({eta}) is before the estimated departure date ({etd}).

EXPORTER_REQUIRED.why: The direction is export, but the exporter is null.
EXPORTER_REQUIRED.fix: Write the exporter for the Japanese export declaration in parties.exporter.

FIELD_PATH_INVALID.why: The fields key "{key}" does not point to an authoritative item ({reason}).
FIELD_PATH_INVALID.fix: Write it as a path to a top-level value (e.g. totals.amount, lines[0].amount).

CONFIDENCE_REQUIRED.why: The value was extracted by ai, but confidence is null.
CONFIDENCE_REQUIRED.fix: Set confidence to a number between 0 and 1.

BBOX_INVALID.why: The position {value} is not in the right order.
BBOX_INVALID.fix: Use [x0, top, x1, bottom] with x0 <= x1, top <= bottom, and all values 0 or more.

DISCREPANCY_NOT_RECORDED.why: The document value "{doc_value}" differs from the authoritative {field} "{auth_value}", but no discrepancy has been recorded.
DISCREPANCY_NOT_RECORDED.fix: Check which is correct, then add an event with type "discrepancy_noted" to events (describe it in note).

PROFILE_UNKNOWN.why: Profile "{value}" is not supported by this validator (supported: {expected}).

PROFILE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.why: Profile version "{value}" is not supported by this validator (supported: {supported}).
PROFILE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Set profile_version to a supported version, or send the message to a party that supports that version.

IN_REPLY_TO_REQUIRED.why: {message_type} is a reply, but it does not say which message it replies to.
IN_REPLY_TO_REQUIRED.fix: Set in_reply_to to the message_id of the message you are replying to.

generic.why: "{value}" is not in the right format.
generic.fix: Fix it to the format defined in the schema.

version.fix: Write three numbers separated by dots (e.g. 0.1.0).

shipment_id.why: "{value}" is not in shipment ID format.
shipment_id.fix: Write SHP-<4-digit year>-<serial of 4 or more digits> (e.g. SHP-2026-0001).

date_calendar.why: "{value}" is not a real calendar date.

datetime.fix: Write it as ISO 8601 with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+09:00).

datetime_calendar.why: "{value}" is not a real date and time.
datetime_calendar.fix: Use a date and time that exist (e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+09:00).

country.why: "{value}" is not in country code format.
country.fix: Write the two uppercase letters of ISO 3166-1 (e.g. JP).

currency.why: "{value}" is not in currency code format.
currency.fix: Write the three uppercase letters of ISO 4217 (e.g. USD).

locode.fix: Write five characters: two for the country and three for the location (e.g. JPYOK).

unit.why: "{value}" is not in unit code format.
unit.fix: Write a UN/ECE Recommendation 20 code of two or three uppercase letters or digits (e.g. KGM).

package_type.why: "{value}" is not in package code format.
package_type.fix: Write a UN/ECE Recommendation 21 code of two uppercase letters or digits (e.g. BG).

iso_type.why: "{value}" is not in container size and type code format.

container_number.why: "{value}" is not in container number format.
container_number.fix: Write four uppercase letters (the fourth is U, J or Z) followed by seven digits (e.g. CSQU3054383).

incoterms.why: "{value}" is not in trade term (Incoterms) format.

incoterms_version.why: "{value}" is not in Incoterms version format.
incoterms_version.fix: Write the four-digit year as a quoted string (e.g. "2020").

amount.fix: Write a decimal with exactly two decimal places as a quoted string (e.g. "22500.00"). Add .00 even for currencies without decimals, such as yen.

quantity.fix: Write a decimal with up to three decimal places as a quoted string (e.g. "18000.000").

weight.fix: Write the weight in kg as a decimal with up to three decimal places, as a quoted string (e.g. "18250.000").

unit_price.why: "{value}" is not in unit price format.
unit_price.fix: Write a decimal with up to six decimal places as a quoted string (e.g. "1.25").

hs_code_jp.why: "{value}" is not in the format of the Japanese commodity code.
hs_code_jp.fix: Write nine digits (the Japanese export statistical code). Use null until it has been confirmed from an official source.

hs_code_dest.why: "{value}" is not in the format of the destination commodity code.
hs_code_dest.fix: Write 6 to 13 digits. Use null until it has been confirmed from an official source.

sha256.fix: Write 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Use null if unknown.

event_type.why: "{value}" is not in event type format.
event_type.fix: Start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits and underscores (e.g. created).

uuid.fix: Write lowercase hexadecimal characters in groups of 8-4-4-4-12 (e.g. 5b0c0c5e-0c1e-4f6a-9d2b-3a1f0e7c9d10).

message_errors.PROFILE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The profile version is not supported, so the message was not processed. The supported version is 0.1.0.
message_errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: The message is incomplete or incorrect. Fix the places listed in issues and send it again with a new message_id.

report.title: Scripted demo record: from quote request to approval
report.intro: This is a record of two parties, the shipper side and the other side (a forwarder that is also a customs broker), exchanging messages in a fixed format. No AI is used; everything follows a fixed script and fixed rules. All data is fictional.
report.transport_note: Nothing is sent over a network in this record. Messages are passed inside one program, and each row shows how it maps onto A2A.
report.legend_rule: A value calculated by a fixed rule, or copied as-is from the authoritative data.
report.legend_unverified: A value that has not been confirmed from an official source. A person must confirm it before use.
report.legend_absent: This record contains no "official data" (values taken from public sources) and no "AI guess", because no public source was consulted and no AI was used.
report.main_title: Main flow: from quote request to approval

quote.title: 1. Quote
quote.text: The shipper side sends the planned shipment and asks for a quote. The other side calculates a quote from a fictional tariff and returns it.

booking.title: 2. Booking
booking.text: The shipper side accepts the quote and asks for a booking. The other side returns a booking number and the schedule.

documents.title: 3. Document submission and discrepancy notice
documents.text: The shipper side submits the shipment data with the values read from the documents. The gross weight on the packing list differs from the authoritative value, so the other side reports the discrepancy and asks for a corrected submission.

resubmission.title: 4. Resubmission and declaration draft
resubmission.text: The shipper side submits again with the corrected document, continuing the same task. With no discrepancies left, the other side returns a (mock) declaration draft.

approval.title: 5. Approval
approval.text: The shipper side checks the declaration draft and approves it. A person makes the decision; the message only carries the result.

resend.title: Extra 1. Resending the same message
resend.text: The shipper side sends the booking request from step 2 again, unchanged. The other side does not process it again and returns the first result as-is. No second booking is made.

version.title: Extra 2. Version mismatch
version.text: The shipper side sends a message in a version the other side does not support (0.2.0). The other side does not process it and declines, stating the supported version.

decline.title: Extra 3. Declining a quote
decline.text: In another conversation, the shipper side receives a quote and declines it. The other side records that and finishes.

carrier.message: On A2A: sent as one Part of a Message (data = envelope, mediaType = application/json)
carrier.artifact: On A2A: returned as the task result (Artifact)
carrier.status: On A2A: returned as a Message attached to the task status
carrier.state: On A2A: only the task status is returned

report.duplicate: Recognised as a resend: not processed, first result returned

fixes.secret: If it is a real key or token, remove it and revoke it with its issuer.
fixes.tracked_private: Remove it from git. The contents of .env and data/private/ never go into git.
fixes.email: For samples and explanations, use reserved names such as example.com.
fixes.phone: If it is a real number, remove it.
fixes.user_path: Remove the user name, or mask it like <name>.
fixes.sample_marker: Make it clearly fictitious: put Sample, Example or Demo in party names and (sample) in descriptions.
fixes.document_file: Check by eye that no real data is shown. Remove the file if it is not needed.
fixes.name_list: Remove the name from that place.
fixes.author: Fixing an author name requires rewriting the history.

prepublish.history_note: Anything found only in the history or in commit messages stays there even after the current files are fixed. Removing it requires rewriting the history, so discuss it before publishing.
